QuestInfo.name: Nix's Gift
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2520021##k gave you an ancient book and a monocle to give to Neinheart.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to return to Neinheart.)#k\r\n
QuestInfo.2: #b#p2520021##k gave you an ancient book and a monocle to give to Neinheart. \r\n

0.0: Here, take this. This book has been handed down since Empress Aria's time. Be careful, it's very old and precious.

yes.0: Oh, the monocle is just a little something for Neinheart. He's a bookworm like me, so he'll need it sooner or later!\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to return to Neinheart.)#k

no.0: You don't need it? Did you forget why you came in the first place?

lost.0: Hey, you can't drop these items. I told you, they're very valuable.

yes.0: Clumsy enough? Be thankful I saw that.
